name: @zipzap/api-client
description: GENERATED from the backend OpenAPI spec. Never hand-edit — regenerate.

scripts.build: pnpm generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/generated.d.ts dist/generated.d.ts

comments.build: tsc does not emit .d.ts inputs to outDir, so dist/index.d.ts imports ./generated.js and never finds it, and every consumer degrades to `any` silently — which is exactly what the hub console hit. Hence `generate` first and `generated.d.ts` copied explicitly. It was a `//build` key before, which is not a comment: JSON has none, so it was a second runnable script that read as a comment, and `generate` was declared twice in the same object for the same reason.
